decision.rationale: No mismatch yet: action-2 staggered probe RMSE 0.0858C and action-4 sustained-both probe RMSE 0.0823C both pass, but passing does not certify unseen schedules. Existing fits compare families only on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 except quadratic_loss on action-2. Use fitting tool to compare linear explanation on expanded evidence initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 plus action-2, action-4 before spending remaining 2 experiments; training fit does not establish mechanism.
